en.title: Legal Basis of Citizenship
en.mnemonic: The legal basis for granting Canadian citizenship traces to Section 5 of the Citizenship Act — if a question asks 'what law says so,' that's the answer.
keyFactsChecklist: Citizenship Act, Section 5 = legal basis for granting citizenship

en.question: The legal basis for granting Canadian citizenship is found in Section 5 of the Citizenship Act.
en.explanation: Section 5 of the Citizenship Act provides the legal basis for granting Canadian citizenship.

optionAnnotations.explanation: Section 5 of the Citizenship Act provides the legal basis for granting Canadian citizenship.
This statement is accurate, so 'False' is incorrect. Section 5 of the Citizenship Act provides the legal basis for granting Canadian citizenship.
